body:
> [!NOTE]
> Please considering donating! It will help me sustain Chiri's development. ❤️
> https://liberapay.com/chloe 

## New
- Added a list of third-party licenses in the "About" settings subtab.
- Added a "working days" scheduling option. You can choose your working days, and Chiri will calculate the next matching day when scheduling tasks.
- Added an option to display a badge for the app icon, which displays the amount of overdue tasks.
- Added an option to export CalDAV accounts as a .mobileconfig file.
- Added an option to manage dates for a task in the task batch actions bar.
- Added an option to wrap task titles onto multiple lines.
- Added brief descriptions for server types explaining their purpose and aim.
- Added categorized predefined filters for dates, statuses, priorities, and organization. Some presets also provide task-creation defaults.
- Added diagnostics reports and log exports to the Data & diagnostics settings.
- Added [Disroot Cloud](https://disroot.org) as a managed CalDAV server type. Supports logging in via browser, as well as manual credentials as login methods.
- Added more sort options for accounts, calendars, and tags in the sidebar.
- Added Mozilla Autopush as a WebDAV Push provider, along with provider availability checks, diagnostics, and configurable VAPID enforcement.
- Added network settings for connectivity probes, request timeouts, and system, HTTP, SOCKS, or disabled proxy modes, plus a more informative offline banner.
- Added options for configurable progress increments, and for choosing what happens when an "In Process" task is checked off.
- Added previews for task-item badges in settings.
- Added Recently Deleted safety controls and batch actions, including configurable retention, automatic cleanup, optional move-to-Recently Deleted confirmation, and parent/subtask deletion behavior.
- Added reset-to-default controls for badge and editor settings.
- Added search to the keyboard shortcuts settings.
- Added [Stalwart](https://stalw.art/) as a self-hosted CalDAV server type. Supports OAuth, as well as manual credentials as login methods.
- Added status as a task sort option.
- Added the ability for dragging in the collapsed view of the sidebar.
- Added the ability to choose a saved filter as the default view when Chiri launches.
- Added the ability to enable, disable, and reorder notification actions, with multiple configurable snooze durations and duration units.
- Added the ability to group tasks.
- Added the ability to move completed tasks to the bottom.
- Added the release date for an update release to the changelog modal's header description.
- Linux: Added full support for AppImage, as well as the option to integrate the app to your desktop.
- Linux: Chiri now has distribution support for Fedora Copr.
- macOS: Added an option for integrated window decorations.
- macOS: Added app-menu navigation for views, filters, calendars, and tags.
- macOS: Added dock-menu actions for creating tasks, syncing, and opening views and saved filters.
- Windows: Chiri is now officially code signed! A special thank you goes to the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/), which made this possible in the first place 🩵
- Windows: Chiri now has official distribution support for Scoop.
- Windows: Chiri now has official distribution support for WinGet.

## Changes
- Added a banner for new calendars and tags when a custom default color is selected in the "Defaults" subtab.
- Added a secondary "View" label to tooltips in the sidebar's collapsed view for views like All Tasks and Recently Deleted.
- Added a tooltip for the "Move" button in the task batch actions bar explaining why the button is disabled if no CalDAV accounts have been added.
- Added inline task and subtask creation inputs in the task list and task editor.
- Added the "Test Connection" button in the context menu for an account item in the sidebar.
- Animations are now motion safe where possible, which should respect the user's system "prefers reduced motion" preference.
- Calendars in the "Move to Calendar" modal are now grouped by account.
- Changed the background of the onboarding to display a solid color instead of a backdrop blur.
- Changed the calendar picker in the destination step of the "Import" modal to use the same picker as the "Move to Calendar" modal.
- Changing the progress in the "Defaults" settings subtab now also changes the status with it.
- Chiri now provides clearer connection notices, test results, errors, OAuth flow messages, and general CalDAV diagnostics.
- Chiri now restores the user's last view immediately during startup.
- Creating a new task now scrolls the task list to where the new task is located.
- Enabling WebDAV Push now requires at least one CalDAV account.
- Improved banners in task editor by having them use the same app design language as everywhere else.
- Improved sort dropdowns by adding consistent visual paddings and spacings.
- Improved the engine logic and parser for .mobileconfig files.
- Improved the experience for account items in the sidebar.
  - Previously, if the account item had a long name, it would get awkwardly cut off in the middle due to the new calendar / account menu buttons. Now, it displays as much as it can unless you hover over the account item, which will reveal the buttons.
  - Hovering over the account item will now extend the hover to the whole width of the account item, instead of just the collapsible / expandable area, unless you hover over one of the buttons on the right, in which case the hover will only be shown to the button your cursor is at.
- Improved the visual state of read-only and disabled fields in the task editor.
- Improved username and password placeholders and labels to be consistent for all server types.
- Improved warning banner messages for all server types.
- Modified the task history entry logic for tasks to now account for a task being imported. Previously, this would incorrectly display a task as being "created".
- Modified the tooltip in the sidebar's collapsed view to differentiate local calendars compared to account calendars.
- Moved helper text for Principal URL and Calendar Home URL fields in the account modals to instead be displayed with tooltips.
- Moved "Sort Direction" in sort dropdowns to instead appear just as an icon in the "Sort By" flyout.
- Onboarding can now be skipped and replayed later from the Data & diagnostics settings.
- Re-organized settings into clearer App, Tasks, Accounts, and Help categories, with new Navigation, Safety, Status & progress, Data & diagnostics, Network, Push, Sync, Scheduling, and List & layout subtabs.
  - Re-organized the "Defaults" settings subtab and added new options. 
  - Added a new "Status & progress" subtab. 
- Refactored modals to use consistent greying-out behavior while adding items.
- Refactored the add account modal to have better cancel buttons & logic between steps.
- Refactored the batch task tags modal to include the cancel button and to not apply changes immediately.
- Refactored the test connection behavior to be more consistent.
- Refreshed the visual design for toasts, and also made them unified and more consistent.
- Slightly improved the design for an interstitial OAuth step for managed server types which provide logging in via the browser.
- Task badges now provide tooltips, and more badges can be clicked to navigate or edit related task data.
- Task editor now differentiates subtasks from regular tasks.
- The active priority in task editor now has a neutral text color.
- The "Add a subtask" button for the task item context menu now creates a subtask and opens the task editor panel instead of summoning a modal.
- The "In Process" status now has a new icon and a new color.
- The onboarding experience now includes startup & window steps.
- The sidebar now displays an icon for when account is disconnected, as well as when an account is (re)connecting.
- The UI for the repeat / recurrence modal has been significantly improved.
  - Now follows the same design language as the date / reminders modals.
  - Added a summary card.
- The "X" close button in modals will now be in the top right if a modal header has a description (otherwise, in the center).
- Tweaked the account step in onboarding. Now when you already have an account added, and decide to go to previous steps, Chiri can gracefully provide a fallback instead of showing the adding account process again.
- Tweaked the visual design of the task history modal by grouping entries by date.
- Visual tweaks for the task batch actions bar in collapsed state.
- When a CalDAV account is disconnected, if the WebDAV Push feature is enabled, WebDAV Push listeners will now be unregistered.
- When dragging an unsupported file to the Chiri app window, we now correctly display an unsupported file toast.
- Linux: The tray is now disabled by default for GNOME users if a tray host is missing.
- Linux: The tray now uses a new engine, ksni, which replaces the old libayatana-appindicator backend. As such, the tray behavior might be slightly different.
- macOS: Notifications now use the Time Sensitive interruption level.

## Removed
- Removed the old global deletion-confirmation controls, including the separate permanent-deletion toggle. Permanent deletions now always require confirmation, while moving tasks to Recently Deleted has its own optional setting.
- Removed "View" as a notification action because it was redundant with the notification's other actions. It displayed a modal containing essentially the same notification actions.
  - On supported platforms, clicking on a notification now highlights the task item.
- Linux: Removed the "Enable window decorations" setting option due to it being rather unreliable. The new default behavior is auto-detection.
- macOS: Removed the redundant "Delete Task" option in the app menu.

## Fixes
- Fixed a potentially rare legacy migration data loss bug.
- Fixed an issue where a task's due-date badge could fail to show its overdue styling.
- Fixed an issue where a user could add reminders to a task in the task editor while simultaneously having the "Reminders" suboption under "Enable notifications" disabled.
- Fixed an issue where a user could receive notifications for a deleted task.
- Fixed an issue where an incorrect publisher name was used for Chiri for platforms like Windows.
- Fixed an issue where calendars created by Apple Reminders would be displayed with a placeholder calendar name in Chiri.
- Fixed an issue where cancelled tasks could still trigger notifications.
- Fixed an issue where clearing a subtask title could delete the subtask.
- Fixed an issue where, during onboarding, toasts might not be displayed.
- Fixed an issue where file extension filtering in the "Import" modal did not function correctly and accepted any extension.
- Fixed an issue where if the app runs into a runtime error, the app continues to run in the background but the actual tray icon is not displayed.
- Fixed an issue where, in the "Manual" sort mode, the cursor is the grab hand when hovering over a task.
- Fixed an issue where OAuth accounts like Fastmail, Nextcloud and others could receive 401 Unauthorized errors by introducing stronger expiry checks.
- Fixed an issue where right clicking a specific place in the accounts section in the sidebar could incorrectly open the browser context menu instead of Chiri's dedicated context menu.
- Fixed an issue where Runbox server type accounts were failing to be added due to an unaccounted HTTPS -> HTTP redirect.
- Fixed an issue where syncing could cause an unrelated task to appear under a selected tag.
- Fixed an issue where the edit account modal would unnecessarily send a request to a CalDAV server if only the account display name field changed.
- Fixed an issue where the priority value of "none" was hardcoded when adding subtasks. Now it respects the "default priority" setting value.
- Fixed an issue where the search bar in the emoji tab in the icon/emoji picker could get cut off as you scrolled.
- Fixed an issue where the time picker modal was missing a border around the footer area.
- Fixed an issue where the yellow color for the Tokyo Night color scheme was inconsistent with the actual color values in the documentation. 
- Fixed an issue where toasts were not always dismissed automatically.
- Fixed borders for color pickers being inconsistent.
- Fixed color-scheme fallback issues, including dark-only schemes appearing in light mode and removed schemes leaving invalid settings behind.
- Fixed deleted subtasks appearing in the "Export" modal.
- Fixed faulty drag boundaries appearing in the sidebar's collapsed view.
- Fixed inconsistent title placeholders for tasks in read-only mode in the task editor.
- Fixed links not being reliably opened externally in the changelog & update modals.
- Fixed local calendars incorrectly having the "Server Order" option be available.
- Fixed logging being polluted:
  - Connectivity checks past initial startup are now only logged if their state changes. 
  - Removed NotificationManagerMock registration spam.
  - Collapsed identifier migration marker logs.
  - Removed duplicate push manager initialized log.
- Fixed not being able to scroll in the account modals.
- Fixed render flashing issues in the icon/emoji picker.
- Fixed server types in the add account modal not having consistent cancel logic.
- Fixed stale pending deletion tombstones for tasks.
- Fixed status & progress fields being coupled together in task editor. You can now hide / show them independently of each other.
- Fixed the calendar field UI being inconsistent for tasks in read-only mode in the task editor.
- Fixed the cancel button not being present in the edit account modal.
- Fixed the cancel button not being present in the export modal.
- Fixed the Ctrl/Cmd+Delete shortcut for deleting tasks not working in the Recently Deleted view.
- Fixed the "recently deleted" toast appearing for discardable (non-modified) tasks.
- Fixed the search bar in the icon/emoji picker to now be more consistent with the rest of the app.
- Fixed the settings modal being unexpectedly smaller if the Chiri window was resized to be small.
- Fixed the WebDAV Push status text always being displayed in the account modal when testing a connection, regardless if WebDAV Push has been enabled or not.
- Linux: Fixed an issue where a user could not log in to Fastmail via OAuth by adding a `MimeType` property to the .desktop file.
- Linux: Fixed an issue where hovering over the tray icon would not display the title (and the description on supported desktop environments).
- Linux: Fixed AppImage unintentionally having self-updating functionality disabled.
- macOS: Fixed an issue where the "Select All" option in the menu did not select all tasks in the task list.
- macOS: Fixed an issue where the "Window" submenu in the app menu was missing quite a lot of options compared to any other app.
- macOS: Fixed being able to check updates in the app menu if Chiri was installed via a managed source (like Homebrew).
- Windows: Fixed an issue where pressing Ctrl+F twice could make the WebView2's search bar to appear.


---

## Major
- Added the Xandikos server type.
- Added experimental support for AppImage builds on Linux.
  - These may not work correctly on all distributions, so please consider [reporting any issues](https://github.com/chiriapp/chiri/issues/new/choose) you encounter.

## Minor
- The ability to register system keyboard shortcuts that are reserved by macOS and Windows is now disabled to prevent any conflicts.
- HTTP / HTTPS schemas are now enforced for server URLs.
- The reset tooltip in the Keyboard shortcuts settings now appears at the top.
- When adding a Fastmail account, the ability to dismiss the modal during the connection process is now disabled.

## Fixes
- Fixed light text appearing when using the light theme in the onboarding process.
- Fixed an overflow text issue for connection alerts in the account modal.
- Fixed an issue where accounts without calendars would be listed in the task defaults settings.
- Fixed an issue where the principal URL for new accounts was not being saved if one was provided.
- Fixed missing descriptions for the Region & time step in the onboarding process.

---

body:
# Info
Chiri is now on [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/chiriapp)! 🩷

Please consider donating to support updates for the project in the long term! Even a small amount goes a long way for rent and food costs. :)

Anyways, onwards with the v0.9.0 changelog!

## Major
- Moved the bundle ID from moe.sapphic.Chiri to garden.chiri.Chiri for consistency as I prepare a proper website for Chiri.
  - Your data should be immediately migrated on app launch.
- Added more installation methods. Chiri is now available for the following platforms:
  - Scoop (Windows): https://github.com/chiriapp/chiri-scoop
  - Homebrew (macOS): https://formulae.brew.sh/cask/chiri
  - Official Nix flake (macOS / Linux): https://search.nixos.org/packages?channel=unstable&query=chiri#show=chiri
    - The regular Nix flake in this GitHub repository is here to stay regardless. You can use it to get Chiri updates faster.

  - More installation methods (i.e. WinGet, Flatpak, and Microsoft Store) are coming soon.

- Added WebDAV Push for near-instantenous syncing whenever there are changes to tasks.
  - Only a limited amount of CalDAV servers, like RustiCal and Nextcloud [with an extension](link), currently support this feature.
  - Currently, only ntfy.sh is supported as a provider on non-Linux platforms. More providers will be available in the future.
    - Linux: Introduced an option to use the KUnifiedPush provider in addition to the ntfy.sh provider for WebDAV Push.
  - See [WEBDAV_PUSH.md](https://github.com/chiriapp/chiri/blob/master/docs/WEBDAV_PUSH.md) for documentation.

- Added batch editing for tasks.

- Added filters in the sidebar.
  - Currently, only predefined filters are available. Support for custom filters will be available in a future version.

- Added support for adding local, offline calendars.

- Added the Recently Deleted view. Tasks here get removed after 30 days.
  - Tasks now no longer permanently delete by default unless you delete them in the Recently Deleted view.

- Added a setting option to enable/disable the cursor pointer for interactive elements.

- Redesigned the account experience.
  - Added OAuth for the Fastmail server type.
  - fruux, Migadu, Purelymail and Runbox added as predefined server types.
  - Added connection notice diagnostics when testing connection or adding an account.
  - Added the ability to use icons and emojis for accounts.
  - Added some helper text for predefined server types. (i.e., use app passwords, enable 2FA, etc)

- Redesigned the theming system.
  - Added color schemes like Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Nord, etc.
  - Vastly improved legibility. No longer do elements share the same color for the background, border, and text.
  - Added an AMOLED flavor for the default color scheme.
  - Softened the accent colors for the default color scheme.
  - Added a setting option to choose to use the accent color for completed checkboxes.

- Introduced a new batch tag edit modal for task editor, task batch editing, and for task defaults.
  - The old Add Tag modal has been removed.

- Redesigned the update modal.
- Redesigned the onboarding experience.

- Tooltips are now accessible when using keyboard tab navigation!

- Connectivity check functionality has been redesigned as the previous one was simply proven to be unreliable.
  - Introduced an option to let users toggle on / off the connectivity check functionality.
  - The default URL for the connectivity check is now the Firefox /success.txt endpoint, though users are able to change this to their own desired URL.

- Improved the sidebar.
  - Added visual padding to the sidebar.
  - Added a subtle top gradient fade for the footer.
  - Restricted drag for sidebar items to their current section. (i.e. account items can only be dragged inside the Accounts section, etc.)
  - Separated the hover areas for sections and section button items.
  - Added helper text for tooltips when in the collapsed sidebar view and hovering over items.
  - Added animation for expanding and collapsing sections in the sidebar.
  - Moved the Import Tasks button to the sidebar footer.

- Improved the keyboard shortcut experience.
  - Introduced keyboard shortcut navigation for date pickers.
  - Slightly improved the keyboard shortcut modal's UI and UX.
  - The "Reset to defaults" button in Settings -> Keyboard shortcuts is now disabled if no shortcuts have been modified.
  - Added the "Import tasks" action as a keyboard shortcut.

- Modals, dropdowns, dialogs and panels now got smarter.
  - Vastly improved the Escape key logic.
  - Disabled being able to accidentally summon another modal while inside an existing modal.

- Added a setting option to launch Chiri on startup, and an option to launch it quietly or not.
  - macOS: Added a setting option to hide the Dock icon when closing the app.

## Minor
- Improved the tooltip for the Sync button in the header.
  - Now shows the last trigger source of the sync.
  - Now shows the calendar name and progress count during a sync.

- Added an option to prefer CalDAV for the default calendar in task defaults. 

- Enabling and disabling the tray no longer requires a restart.
- Added a proper visual interface for the task item repeat badge.

- The Calendar section in task editor now uses the "Move to calendar" modal instead of being a `select` HTML element.
- The default sync interval value is now 15 minutes, up from 5 minutes.
- Slightly improved the bootstrap error screen.
- Added a preview for task list density.
- Better and improved logic for reminder alarms.
- Removed previews from calendars and tags as I found them to be redundant.
- Removed "Close editor" as a keyboard shortcut since it was redundant.
- Removed the legacy "Completed" field for task history entries.
- When dragging tasks, the "Add a task..." button in the task list is now hidden.
- Tooltips for shortcuts now appear to the right to not block text.
- Linux: Added a setting option to enable/disable window decorations.
- macOS: Items in the app menu are now disabled when inside a modal.

## Fixes
- Fixed a minor content jump issue in the task editor when at least one tag was present.
- Fixed an issue where you could tab into items of collapsed sections in the sidebar when using keyboard navigation.
- Fixed the title input field being auto-focused when navigating untitled tasks in the task list.
- Fixed some elements like the "X" (close) button in modals having incorrect focus styling.
- Fixed the tag badge appearing for a task item when viewing a tag in the sidebar.
- Fixed the hardcoded shortcut for the Settings button in the sidebar.
- Fixed inconsistent positions for dropdowns and context menu. This should no longer happen now that these are properly anchored.
- Fixed the external connectivity check triggering on focus.
- Fixed an issue where you could initiate a sync process with a keyboard shortcut with no accounts set up.
- Fixed an issue where a task could get locked from dragging after making it a subtask and then turning it back to a regular task.
- Fixed date picker modals changing height when switching months with differing amount of days.
- Fixed the select HTML component being unreadable on Windows and Linux.
- Fixed an issue where cursors would not correctly reset on WebKit after interacting with dropdowns and context menus.
- Fixed an issue where scrolling with the title input field active on WebKit would cause the app to jump back to the title field when the app's window is focused again.
- macOS: Fixed the "Notification permission is required" text also being affected by opacity.
- macOS: Fixed the Cmd+Q confirmation prompt appearing if you quit Chiri via the app menu or tray.
- macOS: Fixed incorrect Ctrl registration for the keyboard shortcut modal.

name: Chiri v0.8.0
body:
## Major
- The app now has a new name: Chiri, along with a new icon.
  - The default accent color of the app has been changed to pink.
  - The tray now uses monochrome icons that change depending on your system theme.
  - ⚠️ It's advised to uninstall and download the new version of the app if you've been previously using caldav-tasks.

- Improved the context menu for task items:
  - Added the "Set status" dropdown
  - Added the "Move to calendar" button
  - Added the "Change priority" dropdown

- Task Editor:
  - Added a new status feature for tasks. Choose between "Needs Action", "In Process", "Completed", and "Cancelled".
  - Added a new progress feature for tasks that goes from 0% to 100%.
  - Added a new recurring / repeating feature for tasks.
  - Improved UI & UX for subtasks.
    - It's now much easier to add and delete subtasks.
    - You can now rename subtasks by just clicking on them.
    - You can now drag subtasks around and order them. 
  - Added a new "History" feature. This tracks all the edits you've done for a task.

- Improved the experience for the Import Tasks modal:
  - New look
  - Split the steps into multiple parts
  - Now handles Tasks.org backup files

- The date pickers for Start, Due Date and Reminders have been significantly improved:
  - Now features a better and compact UI.
  - Added predefined times that you can change at any time in Settings.

- Settings is now more powerful than ever. Here are some highlights:
  - An improved visual experience across all settings tabs.
  - Added "Diagnostics" and "Reset" sections to the "Data" tab.
  - Tweaked the "Keyboard Shortcuts" tab:
    - Now grouped by category
    - Some keys have been shortened (example: ArrowUp to ↑)
  - The "Look & feel" tab (previously Appearance) now supports: 
    - Task list density
    - Custom colors for accent
    - Changing default colors for calendars and tags
  - The "Notifications" tab now has support for quiet hours and a default time for all-day reminders.
    - You can also now choose what you want to get notifications for: Reminders and Overdue tasks.
  - Added a dedicated "Region & time" tab. You can now change your date format, time format, and quick time presets used in date pickers.
  - You can now toggle which task item badges you wanna see or hide in the new "Badges" tab.
  - The "Defaults" tab now has support for: Status, Progress, Start Date, Due Date, Reminders.
  - You can now toggle which Task Editor fields you wanna see or hide in the new "Editor" tab. 
  - A revamped "About" tab.

- Sidebar:
  - You can now change the sort order of accounts, calendars and tags.
    - Added "Server Order" as a sort option to use the order that the CalDAV server provides.
  - You can now drag accounts, calendars and tags around. 

- Improved the Onboarding experience.

- macOS only:
  - The app is now signed! You will no longer receive a scary popup when launching the app for the first time.
  - Added a Liquid Glass icon variant for macOS.
  - Improved the app menu experience.
  - Added notification actions. Whenever you get a notification, you can now quickly complete it or snooze it.
  - Added a "Require double-press to quit" settings option. Now when you press Cmd+Q, the app will display a toast saying you need to press it again. This is to prevent accidental quits.

## Minor
- The app has been upgraded to Vite 8 and TypeScript 6.
- Visually improved contrast and colors in the Due Date badge for task items.
- You can now search URLs in the search bar for tasks.
- Added a preview for emojis in the emoji picker in calendar and tag modals.
- Added duplication checks for CalDAV accounts. If a user is trying to add a CalDAV account with the same URL and username, the app will now refuse the process.
- The "Reminders" section in Task Editor will now explicitly ask you to enable notifications in settings.
- Added an AppSelect component so that all platforms now have a consistent UI for `<select>` elements.  
- The app now checks if you installed it via a managed packaging system like AUR or Nix, and no longer offers in-app updates.  
- Trimmed the UI for export modals.  
- Log files should now contain way less junk, as useless and redundant data have been trimmed out.  
- Changed the name of export files. (`caldav-settings.json` -> `chiri-settings.json`)  
- macOS:
  - When dealing with notifications, the app will now request for you to grant notification permissions. Until notification permissions have been granted, it will not allow you to enable in-app notifications. This is mostly done so there is less confusion for the user.
  - Added "Sort Direction" in the "View" submenu.

## Fixes
- Fixed the global drag overlay appearing while inside the "Import tasks" modal.  
- Fixed inconsistent focus styles. Now all modals and UI elements should be consistent.  
- Fixed an issue where selecting an emoji would slightly increase the height of calendar / tag modals.  
- Fixed an issue where the cursor will persist having its old state when opening a modal until you moved the cursor.  
- Fixed an issue where creating a subtask through the "Add a subtask" button item via a task item's context menu would not respect the Task Defaults priority.  
- macOS: Fixed an issue where the search bar was missing in the app menu's "Help" submenu.  

---

name: caldav-tasks v0.7.0
body:
# Major
- There is now an ARM build of the app for Windows.
- The "Connections" settings tab has been significantly redesigned.
- The "Task Editor" experience has been significantly redesigned.
- There is now an "Updates" settings tab.
- You can now view changelogs inside the app.
- The "Add CalDAV account" modal now has an option to test a connection with the server.
- The "Nextcloud" and "RustiCal" server types now allow for quick connection with just a server URL via OpenID Connect.
- There is now a "Show unstarted" view option.
- Sorting as well as view options have been consolidated into the "View" dropdown.
- Added support for Fastmail and Mailbox.org server types.
- The app now validates the UI state and resets if an invalid calendar or tag has been passed.
- Removed the legacy subtasks logic that remained unused during the app's early development phase.
  - It has no relation to the current subtasks logic.
- Significantly improved the Onboarding modal.
  - Now provides a warning saying the app is currently in alpha.
  - The "Tags" step has been changed into being able to configure the app instead. (automatic syncing, checking for updates, themes, etc.)
- The app now has better support for .mobileconfig files.
  - Previously, it could only handle a specific, unencrypted variant of .mobileconfig. Now it handles the encrypted variants as well.
  - Added support for server type detection.

# Minor
- The header has received some small visual tweaks.
- When inside a modal, focusing with the Tab key now restricts you to just the elements inside that modal. 
- Focusing with the Tab key has now been significantly improved with better styling.
- Disabled dragging for the 'Smart Sort' sort type.
- If a task item has a start date in the future, the task item's opacity goes down to better indicate visual feedback.
- The app should now have better contrast colors for text & checkboxes.
- The scrollbar is now thinner and automatically disappears after a short time.
- The app now has an error boundary if something goes wrong during runtime.
- The "Check for updates automatically" setting option has been moved to the "Updates" Settings tab.
- Added "Open keyboard shortcuts" and "Toggle unstarted tasks" as configurable shortcuts.
- Added a version number as well a "Report Bug" button in the footer.
- Server types in the "Add CalDAV account" modal have been grouped for visual clarity.
- The error UI during bootstrap has been improved.
- When syncing a calendar through the sidebar, if an error happens, you now receive feedback via toasts.
- The "Default calendar" setting option has been moved to the "Task Defaults" Settings tab.
- Slightly increased the font size for titles in each Settings tab.
- macOS: Added a shortcut in the Notifications Settings tab in order to launch the Notifications settings entry for the app quicker.
- macOS: Disabled the modifier joiner keys in the Shortcuts Settings tab.

# Fixes
- Fixed calendar emojis not appearing in calendar badges for a task item.
- Fixed the "New Calendar" modal's color field not being consistent with the "Edit Calendar" modal.
- Fixed not being able to dismiss a confirm dialog modal while inside another modal.
- Fixed being able to run more than one instance of the app at the same time.
- Fixed double modifier joiner keys appearing for Linux and Windows.
- Fixed the "Save" button in Edit Calendar modal being clickable if the Calendar Name field was empty.

name: caldav-tasks v0.6.0
body:
## Major
  - You can now use emojis alongside icons for calendars and tags.
  - The offline experience has been significantly improved. Now the app should retain most of its functionality even if you lose connectivity.
    - Added a "Sync after connection comes back online" option in Settings.
  - The "Accounts" and "Tags" categories in the sidebar have been redesigned to allow for collapsing and expanding.
  - You can now drag-and-drop Apple Configuration Profile files that contain CalDAV account data to the app. This will spawn an Add "CalDAV Account" modal where the credentials are pre-filled.
  - You can now search in the "Add tag" modal.
  - Trying to connect a CalDAV account with the Vikunja server will now give the user a warning.
    - Unfortunately, Vikunja's CalDAV implementation is rather buggy and I figured I'd just warn the user about an unstable experience instead.

## Minor
  - You can now disable automatically checking for updates in Settings.
  - Sort direction is now disabled for the "Manual" sort option. 
  - The "Default tags" section in Task Defaults now uses the "Add tag" modal rather than displaying all tasks at once. 
  - The "Add a subtask" button in Task Editor now has a dedicated modal instead.
  - The Nix flake now uses a precompiled binary so users no longer have to recompile the app by hand.
  - Clicking on a task for which Task Editor is open now closes the Task Editor.
  - Tooltip text for the Sync button now displays "Sync in progress..." when a sync is happening.
  - The app now displays toasts if errors occur during syncing.
  - Added a tag icon as one of the icons a user can choose for a calendar or a tag.
  - Start date, Due date and Add Reminder modals now have improved UX.
    - Added a "Clear" button in the header.
    - All of the modals now have consistent behavior and do not differ from one modal to another.
    - When selecting a date value, it is no longer immediately applied to the task item. The user now has to confirm their choice.

## Fixes
  - The default icon for tags now use the tag icon, as opposed to the calendar icon.
  - Fixed accent colors being inconsistent across the app.
  - Trimmed down on junk appearing in log files. Now they should be easier to read.
  - Improved the ring outline around a task item when a user has Task Editor open for that task.
  - Restricted selecting to just the <input> and <textarea> elements.
  - You can now scroll left and right with the trackpad on the "Title" input field in the Task Editor.
  - Improved the interactions with the "Sync" button in a calendar's context menu.
  - Improved hover effects for UI elements across the board.
  - Slightly improved the visual experience for context menus and dropdowns.
  - Linux: The GTK title bar should now no longer display for non-GNOME users.
  - macOS: Fixed the "Start Date" option not appearing for "Sort Tasks By" in the app menu.
  - macOS: Fixed the Sync button in the app menu so that it can now have state updates.
  - Nix: Fixed an issue where using the package would give a "Tauri public key is missing" error.
  - Fixed an issue where pressing Escape while having the icon dropdown open (in a New/Edit Calendar/Tag modal) would dismiss the modal instead of just the dropdown.
  - Fixed an issue where if a user has both a context menu as well as the Task Editor open, pressing Escape would dismiss Task Editor first instead of the context menu.
  - Fixed an issue where if a user has both a context menu as well as a modal open (example: Settings), pressing Escape would dismiss the context menu first instead of the modal.
  - Fixed an issue where the account names would always get truncated due to the "Add a new account" and "Account menu" buttons, even if they weren't visible.
  - Fixed an issue where hovering over Reminder items in Task Editor and then moving your cursor away wouldn't hide back the "Edit" and "Remove" buttons.
  - Fixed an issue where clicking anywhere in the "Delete calendar/task/tag" modal with your mouse would dismiss the modal.
  - Fixed Escape key interactions with Task Editor. Now whenever a user is in a modal and has the Task Editor open at the same time, it'll dismiss the modal first rather than dismissing Task Editor first.
  - Fixed an interaction where the "URL" badge for a task item would also open the Task Editor.
  - Fixed an issue where clicking the "URL" badge in a task item wouldn't do anything.
  - Fixed the "Create" button in the New Tag modal being able to be pressed despite the "Tag Name" input field being empty.
  - Fixed the New Tag modal displaying an incorrect icon / defaulting to the calendar icon no matter what.
  - Fixed the "Drop .ics or .json files anywhere to import tasks" overlay appearing behind the "Import Tasks" modal when a user has the "Import Tasks" modal already open.

---
